### Plotting against Lazarus
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/plotting-against-lazarus
Passage: John 12:9-11
Points:
- Crowds arriving in Bethany sought out both Jesus and Lazarus, the man He brought back from death.
- Lazarus' miraculous restoration served as undeniable evidence, leading many Jewish visitors to trust in Christ.
- Seeing their influence slip away, the chief priests plotted to murder Lazarus to silence the living testimony.
- Resentment and petty jealousy drove the religious authorities into irrational hostility against God’s work.
- Believers must vigilantly guard against envy and celebrate the accomplishments and blessings given to others.
